Sophie (Sales): Heads up — customer in fintech asked if we can do a POC fully air-gapped + monthly patch cadence. They care about minimal USB exchanges and signed delta updates.
Max (Solutions Eng): Possible. Recommend delta bundles rather than full images. smaller transfer, faster apply.
Irene (Security): Need to confirm SBOM and signing requirements. They asked for SHA512 signature and chain verification against an enterprise root.
Omar (Ops): Also need to know whether they want OCI images or our legacy tar-bundle. OCI makes layer deltas easier but some sites are strictly tar/ISO.
Sophie (Sales): Customer budget is tight — if we require OCI + custom tooling might push cost up. Can we estimate effort for both?
Max (Solutions Eng): Quick estimate: tar-bundle delta support ~2 engineer-weeks to add delta patcher + validations. OCI delta flow with content-addressable layers ~3-4 wks if we add offline registry tooling.
Irene (Security): Legal also asked for an offline attestation page: list of which binaries changed per patch, CVE mapping, and a PGP-signed manifest. We can supply, but it needs to be part of the release artifact.
Sophie (Sales): They also want license activation without internet — HSM-backed activation or signed license files?
Omar (Ops): We currently support signed license files with activation via offline key import. HSM integration would be additional work and an enterprise add-on.
Legal (bot): FYI — customer flagged indemnity on third-party codecs and audit windows. Contract team will need the exact SBOM format.
Max (Solutions Eng): For the delta workflow proposal: 1) base bundle install 2) delta manifest (json) describing changed files + signed patch 3) apply with atomic swap and rollback on failure. Example manifest snippet: ```json
{
  "base_version": "v1.2.0",
  "patch_version": "v1.2.3",
  "files": ["bin/runtime","lib/llm_weights.q8"],
  "signature": "-----BEGIN PGP SIGNATURE-----..."
}
```
Irene (Security): Need to ensure signatures verify with offline keystore; show commands for auditors.
Max (Solutions Eng): We can provide verification CLI: `redwood-patch verify --manifest patch.json --trusted-root /opt/redwood/trust/ca.pem`
Omar (Ops): Patch apply flow should be idempotent and produce a delta-check log. Also discuss DB migrations: offline site needs an explicit migration plan — no auto-migrations without approval.
Sophie (Sales): Pricing questions: customer asked whether monthly patching is included in Dedicated/reserved pricing, or charged per patch delivery.
Max (Solutions Eng): Typically we include security patching under maintenance for Dedicated customers, but offline packaging and custom delivery (USB courier, signed physical media) would be billed as professional services.
Sophie (Sales): Can you call out ballpark: PS for airgap packaging + per-release signing + docs?
Max (Solutions Eng): Ballpark: $25k one-time for packaging + automation + docs for POC, then $2k per release for packaging/signing and verification artifacts. HSM integration separately quoted.
Irene (Security): Also flag certificate rotation cadence — offline sites want long cert TTLs or explicit manual rotation procedures. Recommend we support cert bundle rotation via signed rotation packages every 6-12 months.
Sophie (Sales): They asked about telemetry: can we offer a push to an internal collector when the site briefly connects, or must logs be entirely offline?
Omar (Ops): We support both. For strict air-gap they will likely want purely offline logs that Security ingests manually. For hybrid, we can queue metrics and forward during maintenance windows.
Sophie (Sales): Customer also raised an enterprise blocker: SOC2 box wants proof of rollback testing and canary policy for patches.
Max (Solutions Eng): For POC we can do a staged canary using a single node and provide runbooks + automated smoke tests. Canary runbook example in repo.
Irene (Security): Suggest we include a short runbook attachment in the artifact: steps to validate, rollback, and contact info for emergency support.
Sophie (Sales): OK — action items: Max to draft delta bundle spec + CLI sample, Omar to document ops/runbook and offline migration plan, Irene to list SBOM/signing requirements and sample verification commands, Legal to prepare contract notes for indemnity/license activation.
Max (Solutions Eng): Will have a first draft spec by EOD Tuesday.
Omar (Ops): I’ll draft the runbook + DB migration checklist by Wed.
Irene (Security): I’ll put together the SBOM template and sample PGP verification commands, and note our recommended signing algos.
Legal (bot): Contract team will sync after we have exact SBOM format and indemnity ask.
Sophie (Sales): Thanks team — looping customer in tomorrow with this plan. ping @deploy-bot to create a delivery channel and attach initial spec when ready :)
